name: OpenAI-compatible chat API
author: Oxelis
description: Translation with a large language model behind an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API, such as OpenAI, DeepSeek, or a model served locally (for example Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1, which needs no key and works offline). The plugin can reach only the address entered in its settings.
